theorems.name: Submission.codim1_ac_submanifold_area_formula
theorems.statement: ∀ (P m : ℕ) (N : Set (Euclid P)) (Q : Euclid P → Submodule ℝ (Euclid P)) (Φ : Euclid P → Euclid P), 1 ≤ m → IsEmbeddedSubmanifold 1 m N → (∀ x ∈ N, (Q x : Set (Euclid P)) = tangentSpace N x) → ContDiff ℝ 1 Φ → Injective Φ → (∀ x, Injective (fderiv ℝ Φ x)) → ContinuousOn (fun x => Real.sqrt (Matrix.det (Matrix.of fun i j : Fin (Module.finrank ℝ (Q x)) => inner ℝ (fderiv ℝ Φ x (stdOrthonormalBasis ℝ (Q x) i)) (fderiv ℝ Φ x (stdOrthonormalBasis ℝ (Q x) j))))) N ∧ ∀ B : Set (Euclid P), B ⊆ N → MeasurableSet B → ∀ g : Euclid P → ℝ≥0∞, ∫⁻ y in Φ '' B, g y ∂μHE[m] = ∫⁻ x in B, ENNReal.ofReal (Real.sqrt (Matrix.det (Matrix.of fun i j : Fin (Module.finrank ℝ (Q x)) => inner ℝ (fderiv ℝ Φ x (stdOrthonormalBasis ℝ (Q x) i)) (fderiv ℝ Φ x (stdOrthonormalBasis ℝ (Q x) j))))) * g (Φ x) ∂μHE[m]
